name: Cherry Moderate
source:
Hero and his classmate argued about who of them was more popular with the girls. Now with the nanpa competition launched hero needs to win the hearts of as many girls as possible.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与同班同学争论谁更受女生欢迎。如今，搭讪比赛已经开始，他必须尽可能赢得更多女孩的芳心。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
